+name: Hepta Windows scope-lane WAL recovery
+
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    paths:
+      - "codex-rs/hepta-control-plane/src/scope_lane_wal.rs"
+      - "codex-rs/hepta-control-plane/src/scope_lane_wal_tests.rs"
+      - "codex-rs/Cargo.lock"
+      - ".github/workflows/hepta-windows-scope-lane-wal.yml"
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: hepta-windows-scope-wal-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+
+env:
+  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
+  CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: "2"
+  CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG: "0"
+  CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG: "0"
+
+jobs:
+  windows-crash-tail:
+    runs-on: windows-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 70
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout exact candidate
+        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+          persist-credentials: false
+      - name: Install pinned Rust toolchain
+        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@e081816240890017053eacbb1bdf337761dc5582
+        with:
+          components: rustfmt
+      - name: Verify immutable checkout and Cargo graph
+        shell: bash
+        env:
+          EXPECTED_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_SHA"
+          rustc --version
+          cargo metadata --manifest-path codex-rs/Cargo.toml --locked --no-deps --format-version 1 > /dev/null
+      - name: Run actual Windows scope-lane WAL crash recovery
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          cargo test --manifest-path codex-rs/Cargo.toml --locked --lib -p codex-hepta-control-plane scope_lane_wal -- --test-threads=1
+      - name: Check control-plane source formatting
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          cargo fmt --manifest-path codex-rs/Cargo.toml --package codex-hepta-control-plane -- --check
+      - name: Confirm checkout unchanged
+        if: always()
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          git diff --exit-code
+          git diff --cached --exit-code

@@ -0,0 +1,119 @@
+name: Hepta P0 Windows WAL and Supervisor recovery (qualification only)
+
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    paths:
+      - "codex-rs/hepta-control-plane/src/scope_lane_wal.rs"
+      - "codex-rs/hepta-control-plane/src/scope_lane_wal_tests.rs"
+      - "codex-rs/hepta-supervisor/src/tick.rs"
+      - "codex-rs/hepta-supervisor/tests/restart_budget.rs"
+      - "codex-rs/hepta-supervisor/tests/restart_budget_recovery.rs"
+      - "codex-rs/hepta-fleet/src/authority_port.rs"
+      - "codex-rs/Cargo.lock"
+      - ".github/workflows/hepta-p0-windows-wal-restart-20261019.yml"
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+jobs:
+  native-crash-recovery:
+    name: WAL and restart recovery on ${{ matrix.os }}
+    strategy:
+      fail-fast: false
+      matrix:
+        os: [ubuntu-24.04, windows-latest]
+    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
+    timeout-minutes: 80
+    env:
+      CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
+      CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: "2"
+      CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG: "0"
+      CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG: "0"
+    steps:
+      - name: Check out exact source
+        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+          persist-credentials: false
+      - name: Install pinned Rust 1.95
+        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@e081816240890017053eacbb1bdf337761dc5582
+        with:
+          components: rustfmt
+      - name: Verify exact checkout and locked workspace
+        shell: bash
+        env:
+          EXPECTED_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_SHA"
+          rustc --version
+          cargo metadata --manifest-path codex-rs/Cargo.toml --locked --no-deps --format-version 1 >/dev/null
+      - name: Exercise real scope WAL crash-tail reopen and replay
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          cargo test --manifest-path codex-rs/Cargo.toml --locked -p codex-hepta-control-plane --lib scope_lane_wal -- --test-threads=1
+      - name: Exercise Supervisor durable restart and exhaustion
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          cargo test --manifest-path codex-rs/Cargo.toml --locked -p codex-hepta-supervisor --test restart_budget -- --test-threads=1
+          cargo test --manifest-path codex-rs/Cargo.toml --locked -p codex-hepta-supervisor --test restart_budget_recovery -- --test-threads=1
+      - name: Enforce source formatting
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          cargo fmt --manifest-path codex-rs/Cargo.toml --package codex-hepta-control-plane --package codex-hepta-supervisor -- --check
+      - name: Verify tests did not modify source
+        if: always()
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          git diff --exit-code
+          git diff --cached --exit-code
+  native-fleet-clippy:
+    name: Strict Fleet Clippy on macos-15
+    runs-on: macos-15
+    timeout-minutes: 70
+    env:
+      CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
+      CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: "2"
+      CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG: "0"
+      CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG: "0"
+    steps:
+      - name: Check out exact source
+        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+          persist-credentials: false
+      - name: Install pinned Rust toolchain and Clippy
+        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@e081816240890017053eacbb1bdf337761dc5582
+        with:
+          components: clippy,rustfmt
+      - name: Assert head and locked metadata
+        shell: bash
+        env:
+          EXPECTED_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_SHA"
+          cargo metadata --manifest-path codex-rs/Cargo.toml --locked --no-deps --format-version 1 >/dev/null
+      - name: Run signed Fleet authority fixture tests
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          cargo test --manifest-path codex-rs/Cargo.toml --locked -p codex-hepta-fleet --lib authority_port::tests
+      - name: Enforce strict Clippy without waivers
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          cargo clippy --manifest-path codex-rs/Cargo.toml --locked -p codex-hepta-fleet --lib --tests -- -D clippy::expect_used -D clippy::unwrap_used
+      - name: Check formatter and immutable checkout
+        if: always()
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          cargo fmt --manifest-path codex-rs/Cargo.toml --package codex-hepta-fleet -- --check
+          git diff --exit-code
+          git diff --cached --exit-code
